scope: All Solar System catalogue bodies, all recognized planetary/Pluto moons from JPL, dwarf-planet satellites, 20 closest confirmed archive exoplanets, and 20 stellar components from the Gaia-era nearby snapshot. Individual material/atmosphere assumptions must be explicit. Do not invent solid surfaces for stars or gas giants.
inventoryWorkRemaining: Refresh nearest stellar ranking from current astrometry before claiming an exhaustive present-day boundary.
Inventory remaining satellites of asteroids and other minor planets separately.
Add further recognized dwarf planets if the IAU roster changes; candidates remain marked candidates.

selection.planets: 20 confirmed archive planets by host heliocentric distance; each planet counts separately. Equal host distances sorted by planet name. Distances and composite measurements have individual reference histories.
selection.stars: 20 stellar components excluding Sol, planets and brown dwarfs, sorted by inverse parallax. Includes white dwarfs. Source snapshot is historical; boundary membership needs current Gaia/SIMBAD verification before claiming an exhaustive current ranking.
